Shield,Ⓒs.Ⓓcarman n., PalakaH-kaM, PalaM; ‘armed with a s(hield)’ carmin, PalakapARi, PalaBft; ‘having sword and s(hield)’ KaqgacarmaDara.
Ⓑ
 2 ASrayaH, SaraRaM, rakzaRaM, gupti f.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓrakz 1 P, trE 1 A, A-, Cad 10; See Protect.

Shift,Ⓒs.ⒹupAyaH, pra-, yukti f., gati f., sADanaM, prayogaH.
Ⓑ
 2 CalopAyaH, kapawaM, Cadman n., CalaM, apa-vyapa-deSaH.
Ⓑ
 3 aMtarIyaM, aDoM-SukaM, aDovasanaM.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓpari-vyA-vft 1 A.
Ⓑ
 2 vi-, cal 1 P, sTAnAMtaraM gam 1 P or cal. []
Ⓑ
 3 vastrAMtaraM pari-DA 3 U; ‘s(hift) for one self’ vfttiM-jIvikAM-upapad c. or prakxp c.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓpari-vyA-vft c., anyaTA kf 8 U, vikf.
Ⓑ
 2 vical c., sTAnAMtaraM gam c. or cal c.
Ⓝ[Shift]y,Ⓒa.ⒹCala-kapawa-priya.

Shine,Ⓒv. i.ⒹprakAS 1 A, pra-, BA 2 P, vi-, dyut 1 A, SuB 1 A, dIp 4 A, rAj 1 U, BAs 1 A, sPur 6 P, BrAj-BrAS-BlAS 1 A, cakAs 2 P, pra-, ruc 1 A, jval 1 P, vilas 1 P; ‘stars s(hine) by their own light’ svataHprakASAH tArakAH.
Ⓔs.ⒹprakASaH, dyuti f., praBA; See Light.
Ⓝ[Shin]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹBA-svat, dyuti-dIpti-mat, BAsura, rucira, teja-svin, kAMtiyukta, BrAjamAna, dyotamAna, &c.
Ⓝ[Shin]y,Ⓒa.ⒹBAsvat; See above.

Ship,Ⓒs.ⒹpotaH; yAnaM, pravahaRaM, (the sense being clear); bfhannOkA-taraRi-RI f.; ‘s(hip) master’ nOkADipatiH, potADyakzaH.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓ(Off) potena prasTA c. or pra-hi 5 P, potaM Aruh c., nOkAyAM praviS c.
Ⓑ
 2 svasTAne niviS c.
ⓃShipwreck,Ⓒs.ⒹyAna-pota-BaMgaH, nOvyasanaM-BaMgaH-BedaH; (fig.) viDvaMsaH, ucCaMdaH, praRASaH; ‘suffered a s(hipwreck)’ yAnaBaMgena sAgare nimagnaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹnAvaM-potaM-BaMj 7 P or naS c.; ‘her hopes were s(hipwreck)ed’ sarvA ASA unmUlitAH, mUlacCinnA iva.

Shirk,Ⓒv.ⒹsavyAjaM-Calena-parihf 1 P or tyaj 1 P or hA 3 P; apa-vyapa-diS 6 P, CalaM-Cadma-kf 8 U; vyapa-sfp 1 P, vyapakram 1 U, 4 P, palAy 1 A.
Ⓝ[Shirk]er,Ⓒs.ⒹkAryatyAgin m.

Shiver,Ⓒv. i.ⒹkaMp-vep- 1 A, sItkAraM muc 6 P; ‘s(hiver)ing with cold’, SItakaMpitatanu, SItArtatvAt kaMpamAna, ‘with s(hiver)ing force’ sataralavegaM.
Ⓑ
 2 bahuKaMqaSaH Bid-vidF- pass., Saka-lIBU 1 P.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹSakalIkf 8 U, bahuKaMqaSaH Bid 7 P or vidF 9 P or c., sahasraDA BaMj 7 P.
Ⓔs.Ⓓpra-, kaMpaH, vepaTuH, sItkAraH, deha-gAtra-kaMpaH.
Ⓑ
 2 SakalaH-laM, KaMqakaH, sUkzmalavaH, dalaM, CedaH, BinnaM; ‘went to a hundred s(hiver)s’ SataKaMqIBUtaH SataDA BinnaH.
